title: agathis robusta
intro: Agathis robusta, commonly known as Kauri or Red Kauri, is a type of coniferous tree native to the eastern coast of Australia and New Zealand. The health benefits of Agathis robusta include its potential to reduce inflammation, improve cardiovascular health, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce anxiety, and promote relaxation, which is largely due to the presence of bioactive constituents such as sesquiterpenes and lignans. The bioactive constituents in Agathis robusta have been identified to include sesquiterpenes, lignans, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
